text: Hint 1: Consider the biological significance of codons in DNA sequences. Each codon, a sequence of three nucleotides, corresponds to a specific amino acid or a stop signal during protein synthesis. How might this biological function influence your choice of encoding strategy?\n\nHint 2: Think about the trade-off between compactness and preserving meaning. A more compact representation might be appealing, but it should not come at the cost of losing important information about the sequence of codons and their potential interactions. How does one-hot encoding of codons balance these considerations?
